items.title: Verlorene Seelen. Ein Krimi aus Passau
items.overview: In ihrem zehnten gemeinsamen Fall kommt es auf dem Ausflugsschiff "Queen Danubia" einer Passauer Reederei immer wieder zu nächtlichen Einbrüchen. Der Privatermittler Ferdinand Zankl soll dem Spuk ein Ende bereiten und übernimmt die Überwachung des Schiffes, das im Industriehafen vor Anker liegt. Nach einem unglücklichen Sturz auf den Kopf glaubt Zankl eine Wasserleiche in der Donau zu sehen, die jedoch gleich wieder versinkt. Ex-Polizistin Frederike Bader nimmt Zankls Beobachtung zunächst nicht ernst. Doch dann erfährt sie, dass Hans Lindegger (Martin Weinek), Wiener Kapitän eines benachbart vor Anker liegenden Transportschiffs, verschwunden ist. Sein Neffe Lenny Lindegger (Simon Morzé) vermisst ihn, seit es in der Nacht zuvor wieder einmal einen Einbruch auf der "Queen Danubia" gab. Welche Informationen hält der alte Fischer Thade Gutsmiedel (Michael Roll) vom gegenüberliegenden Ufer zurück?

items.title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
items.overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

items.title: I Matter
items.overview: As she stands on the verge of leaving the orphanage she called home, Rebeca, a young Roma girl, clings to the hope that her father's release from prison will finally give her the family she has always longed for. When she is accepted into university to study acting, life finally seems to be opening up for her. But just as Rebeca begins to find her place in this new world, the life she comes from starts to catch up with her, forcing her to make choices she can no longer postpone.

items.title: Voices in my Head
items.overview: Recently, a tragedy deeply shook the siblings Sarah and Kevin. Their parents died in a car accident. Sarah suffers greatly from the loss. She is convinced that her parents were murdered by a creepy woman who haunts their home. Increasingly, Kevin must realize that his sister is in great danger.

items.title: Letters from the Silenced Country
items.overview: A hybrid documentary portraying contemporary Belarus through the individuals who have endured imprisonment, repression, and exile — voices from a silenced country, suffocated by the regime.

items.title: Drawn Together
items.overview: Marfil Cortés, a daughter of a wealthy Spanish businessman, is kidnapped and released, leading her father to hire Sebastian Moore as a bodyguard. Despite initial clashes, they form an irremediable attraction, navigating a world where no one is who they say they are.

items.title: Lion Fist
items.overview: Martial Arts Fighter Joe goes to prison for 4 years and takes his wife's blame for a Drug Bust. After his release he finds out that his ex gave birth to his son and started a new life with a Drug Lord.

items.title: The Train
items.overview: Vienna today. Visionary Leo Goldberg readies the sale of his legendary Majestic Imperator train. As rival investors and a deadly Russian spy board, British Major Alexander Stirling must battle conspirators to save his daughter, the train.

items.title: Ignition
items.overview: *Ignition* is a real-time psychological thriller about bomb disposal officer Leon Colter. A routine call turns deadly when a device triggers a countdown, drawing him into a sadistic game led by a voice that knows his secrets.

items.title: Low Expectations
items.overview: At the height of her music career, Maja falls apart and has to step away from her ambitions. Depressed and broke, she moves back home with her mother and works part-time at a local high school. Far from the spotlight, wrapped in everyday kindness, she slowly finds her way back to life.

items.title: In My Pain
items.overview: A powerful true story of Sharon McKinney, a woman who spent much of her life trapped in a cycle of abuse, and addiction. After nearly losing her life, Sharon reaches rock bottom before finding hope through faith.

items.title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
items.overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

items.title: Company
items.overview: A mysterious traveler tells a story that spans generations, drawing together the lives of three wounded souls struggling to choose between vengeance and forgiveness.

items.title: The Militia
items.overview: Daniel Pierce dreams of joining the local Militia alongside his father once he turns eighteen, but when his Dad becomes the target of the local Sheriff, Daniel and his friends form their own militia in a troubled effort to save him.

items.title: Maremma
items.overview: A young man navigates the traditions and realities of rural Telangana, where folklore shapes daily life. When community tensions surface, his journey takes an intense turn.

items.title: A Marble in the Jar
items.overview: "A Marble in the Jar" follows surfer Tatiana Weston-Webb's rise and return amid women's surfing's push for equality, while coach and director, Greg Browning's, ALS battle re-frames the story as one of resilience and small, meaningful wins.

items.title: Girl Group
items.overview: A pop diva, kicked out of her own group's reunion tour and slapped with a community service court order, seizes the chance to stage a comeback by coaching a group of misfit teen girls for a major record label audition, only to push them too far, forcing her to confront her toxic industry — and her own streak of self-destruction.

items.title: The Surgeon
items.overview: A former surgeon is kidnapped and given an impossible choice.
